profile.headline: Senior Interactive Web Developer at AAFES
profile.summary: Frontend Web Developer with over 10 years of experience in crafting responsive, user-centric web applications. Proficient in modern web technologies and skilled in optimizing performance and accessibility, enhancing user engagement and achieving business objectives. Demonstrates expertise in Salesforce Commerce Cloud and task automation, with a proven track record of leading successful projects across multiple regions.

positions.title: Senior UI Developer
positions.description:
- Led the automation of batch processes in Salesforce Commerce Cloud using Node.js, improving operational efficiency and reducing manual workload.
- Oversaw the successful launch of katchin.com, collaborating cross-functionally to deliver a high-performing, scalable brand site.
- Served as lead developer for watchstation.com and skagen.com across multiple international markets (US, Canada, UK, Germany, France, Japan), ensuring consistent user experience and site performance.
- Elevated brand marketing campaigns by developing interactive content and optimizing site presentation, resulting in increased user engagement.
- Provided process and delivery oversight to in-region team members, fostering collaboration and knowledge sharing.
- Developed content solutions aligned with industry best practices in technology, features, performance, and scalability.
- Partnered with merchandising, marketing, and design teams to meet business goals, ensuring each release met accessibility standards and delivered optimal site performance.
- Collaborated with QA teams on integration, system, and performance testing, ensuring high-quality, reliable releases.
positions.insights: Skills: GreenSock Animation Platform (GSAP) · HTML 5 · CSS · Bootstrap (Framework) · JavaScript · Salesforce

positions.title: Front End Web Developer
positions.description:
- Created and managed front-end content for Salesforce Commerce Cloud, streamlining content entry and asset management processes.
- Scheduled content slots, managed digital assets, and created categories to support marketing initiatives and improve site organization.
- Translated design comps into responsive, SEO-friendly websites and rich media, enhancing usability and accessibility.
- Collaborated with strategy, creative, and development teams to deliver high-quality web pages and updates within tight deadlines.
- Maintained and expanded expertise in rich media tools and emerging technologies, driving innovation in social media web applications.
positions.insights: Skills: Salesforce · HTML · CSS · JavaScript · jQuery

positions.title: Front End Web Developer
positions.description:
- Provided strategic input to management on page and interface design, contributing to improved user experience.
- Rendered web pages in HTML using Dreamweaver and hand coding, ensuring adherence to project requirements and brand standards.
- Developed responsive pages with HTML5, CSS3, and jQuery, increasing mobile accessibility and user satisfaction.
- Created and distributed corporate emails using mass email best practices, supporting internal communications.
- Edited graphics and created sprites with Photoshop and Fireworks, enhancing site visuals and performance.
- Conducted browser compatibility testing across Internet Explorer, Firefox, and Chrome, ensuring consistent user experience.
- Adapted pages for integration with proprietary CMS, streamlining content management workflows.
- Converted the employee website (my.aa.com) to a responsive HTML5 design, improving accessibility and engagement.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Developed and maintained landing pages and enrollment forms for a proprietary credit monitoring product, supporting marketing and sales initiatives.
- Rendered web pages using Dreamweaver, Visual Studio, and hand coding, ensuring high-quality, standards-compliant output.
- Created responsive mobile pages with HTML5, CSS3, and jQuery, expanding reach to mobile users.
- Integrated front-end UI with back-end controls, enhancing functionality and user experience.
- Edited graphics and created sprites with Photoshop and Fireworks, optimizing site performance.
- Conducted browser compatibility testing to ensure seamless user experience across major browsers.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Designed, administered, and updated internal and external websites, ensuring security and compliance with agency standards.
- Led software upgrades and enhancements, improving site functionality and reliability.
- Trained users on new web products and access, increasing adoption and reducing support requests.
- Provided site support to public and agency personnel, ensuring timely resolution of issues.
- Coordinated content accuracy and information control for website submissions, maintaining data integrity.
- Collaborated with administrative web group to uphold standards compliance and integrate web products with other agencies.
- Played a key role in the success of the "IT Initiative" project, contributing to committee work and project presentations.
- Recommended hardware and software upgrades, driving continuous improvement.

positions.title: Military Police/Nuclear, Biological, and Chemical (NBC) Defense Specialist
positions.description:
- Conducted and supervised NBC defense training, including monitoring, surveying, and reconnaissance of chemical and biological threats.
- Trained first aid personnel in protective measures, enhancing team readiness and safety.
- Assisted NBC defense officers in mission planning and execution, ensuring successful completion of objectives.
- Maintained and serviced NBC defense equipment and supplies, supporting operational effectiveness.
